_nota: Traducción al inglés, hecha a mano, de los textos de plagas_confirmadas.json. Una entrada por id de registro. Los nombres de taxón no se traducen. Si un registro nuevo no tiene entrada aquí, el generador deja el texto en español y lo avisa.

maiz-06.limite: ICTA/VISAR diagnosis; do not infer presence in Chiquimula.

frijol-01.lugar: Petén, El Progreso, Zacapa and Chimaltenango (2022 sampling); San Jerónimo, Baja Verapaz (study described by ICTA)
frijol-01.limite: The ICTA page describes 2022 sampling and observations in beans. Its damage percentages are not extrapolated to other localities.

frijol-08.limite: Historical taxonomic record on Phaseolus vulgaris; Guatemala department. The name from the identification of that time is kept.

frijol-20.limite: Historical record on Phaseolus vulgaris; name used in the article, without current molecular review.

cebolla-01.limite: 19 onion samples, 11 of them for entomology. This does not equal 11 farms and does not estimate prevalence.

cebolla-02.lugar: Chimaltenango (2000 trial); Chimaltenango, Sololá and Quetzaltenango (UVG table, 1997)
cebolla-02.limite: Two local sources: a historical UVG identification and an ICTA/JICA trial. One crop–taxon relationship, without duplicating records.

brocoli-01.lugar: Central and western highlands of Guatemala; regional precision, without fixing the individual trial site here
brocoli-01.limite: The original abstract describes an evaluation against this species in broccoli. Access to the full text is limited; each EPS locality is not assigned to the trial.

brocoli-02.limite: Historical record with prior sampling in the plots. P. obsoleta and P. menetriesi remain as detail of the complex, without adding entries.

brocoli-04.limite: Historical record; name from the identification of that time. Original table inspected visually.

lechuga-01.limite: Observation during a hydroponic trial; not identified to species.

lechuga-02.limite: Monitoring results; the author assigns the species, with no located detail of keys or reference specimens.

lechuga-03.limite: Historical record with taxonomic identification; it does not show current frequency or presence in Chiquimula.
